name: Hilbana
description: Your Hilbana issues inside Orca: list, filters, search, detail, state changes, comments, a status bar counter and a button that runs the Hilbana command in your agent.

settings.title: Hilbana MCP server URL
settings.description: Must be https:// (http:// only for localhost). The API key is sent only to this URL. It is not stored here: paste it in the panel.

settings.title: Prompt sent to the agent
settings.description: Typed into the focused workspace's agent when you press "Run in agent" on an issue. {identifier} is replaced by the issue identifier (e.g. DRAPPS-123). Default: the Hilbana plugin command. Use plain text for agents without slash commands.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Open the Hilbana panel to connect.
